class.name: AISandbox
class.brief_description: Explicit sandbox for AI-driven capabilities and function overrides.
class.description: [AISandbox] is a small permission boundary for AI integrations. Scripts register named capabilities and overrides as [Callable] values, then AI-facing code can execute only those registered names through this node. Capabilities receive one [Variant] payload. Overrides receive the original value and a context [Dictionary], and return a replacement value through the result dictionary. Every execution returns a dictionary with [code]ok[/code], [code]status[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]handled[/code], [code]value[/code], and [code]error[/code] fields.

method.name: apply_override
method.description: Applies the registered override named [param name]. If no override is registered, returns [param original_value] with [code]handled[/code] set to [code]false[/code].

method.name: execute_capability
method.description: Executes the registered capability named [param name], passing [param payload] to its callback.

method.name: get_capability_options
method.description: Returns the options dictionary for a registered capability, or an empty dictionary.

method.name: get_override_options
method.description: Returns the options dictionary for a registered override, or an empty dictionary.

method.name: has_capability
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param name] is registered as a capability.

method.name: has_override
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param name] is registered as an override.

method.name: register_capability
method.description: Registers a named capability. Set [code]options.writes[/code] to [code]true[/code] for callbacks that mutate project or scene state so [member read_only] can deny them.

method.name: register_override
method.description: Registers a named override. Override callbacks receive [code](original_value, context)[/code].

members.member: If [code]false[/code], [method apply_override] denies all registered overrides.
Default timeout metadata copied into capability and override options when no [code]timeout[/code] option is provided.
If [code]false[/code], all capability and override execution is denied.
If [code]true[/code], entries whose options contain [code]writes = true[/code] are denied.

signal.name: capability_executed
signal.description: Emitted after a capability execution attempt.

signal.name: capability_registered
signal.description: Emitted when a capability is registered or replaced.

signal.name: override_applied
signal.description: Emitted after an override application attempt.

signal.name: override_registered
signal.description: Emitted when an override is registered or replaced.

constants.constant: The requested capability or override was not found.
The sandbox policy denied the operation.
